verdict.rationale: Overage pricing transparency is a fair question for a usage-billed hosting platform, but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an overage fee schedule for bandwidth, function invocations, or build minutes. Community reports point the other way: one user received a surprise $104k bill after a DDoS, and another could not find pricing at all. There is no vendor claim to contradict, so the verdict is "none" rather than "disputed".
